Apple Inc. is audited by **Ernst & Young LLP**.  
The 2026 Form 10‑K for Apple states that Ernst & Young LLP has served as the Company’s auditor since 2009 and signed the audit report dated November 3, 2026【Doc 2】.

Microsoft Corporation is audited by **Deloitte & Touche LLP**.  
The 2026 Form 10‑K for Microsoft lists Deloitte & Touche LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm that audited the Company’s consolidated financial statements and internal control over financial reporting for the year ended June 30, 2026【Doc 5】.
